title: Allodial Title Via Land Patents #1 - Explained
summary: Promoter reads the opening of a land-patent 'allodial title' primer and says he does not pay income tax.

assertions.quote: how to go about um doing the land patent and getting your property off the tax roll

verdicts.note: The Seventh Circuit called a self-drafted 'land patent' recorded to defeat a mortgage a blatant attempt to improve title by personal fiat; it did not improve title, foreclosure stood, and the court imposed sanctions for a frivolous appeal.

assertions.quote: I had heard that the income tax was voluntary. It sure is.

verdicts.note: IRC 1 imposes the tax and 6151 requires payment; 'voluntary' in Flora refers to self-assessment, and multiple circuits (8th Drefke, 9th Wilcox, 2d Banat) reject the voluntary-payment argument as frivolous with sanctions.
